name: Levitation Crunch
summary: A crunch variation where the shoulder blades are lifted straight up toward the ceiling with the arms overhead to emphasize upper abdominal contraction.

setup: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor roughly hip-width apart.
Extend your arms overhead or cross your forearms above your head without clasping your hands behind your neck.
Flatten your lower back firmly against the floor to posteriorly tilt the pelvis.
steps: Exhale and lift your shoulder blades straight up off the floor toward the ceiling, keeping your lower back anchored down.
Pause at the top for one to two seconds, focusing on a maximal contraction in the upper abdominals.
Inhale as you lower your torso under control until your shoulder blades lightly touch the floor, maintaining tension throughout.
instructions.breathing: Exhale forcefully as you lift straight up toward the ceiling, and inhale smoothly as you lower your upper back to the mat.
cues: Drive your chest straight to the ceiling.
Keep your lower back glued to the floor.
Don't yank your head or tuck your chin into your chest.

common_faults.fault: Curling the torso forward instead of lifting straight upward.
common_faults.correction: Focus on elevating the ribcage and shoulder blades directly toward the ceiling rather than rolling toward your knees.

common_faults.fault: Pulling on the cervical spine with the hands.
common_faults.correction: Keep your arms crossed overhead or keep hands lightly touching the temples without pulling the neck.

common_faults.fault: Arching the lumbar spine off the floor during the lift.
common_faults.correction: Maintain abdominal brace and keep the lumbar spine pinned against the mat throughout the entire movement.

precautions: Keep the neck relaxed and aligned with the spine to avoid cervical strain.
